evidence.abstract: In this article, we describe an implementation of a polynomial system solver to compute the approximate solutions of a 0-dimensional polynomial system with finite precision p-adic arithmetic. We also describe an improvement to an algorithm of Caruso, Roe, and Vaccon for calculating the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a p-adic matrix.
evidence.arxiv_title: Solving p-adic polynomial systems via iterative eigenvector algorithms

bibtex.title: Solving p-adic polynomial systems via iterative eigenvector algorithms
